SELECT to_char(T0.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as balanceDate,/**日期**/ T1.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId,/**账套代码**/ T1.BOOKSET_NAME as booksetName,/**账套名称**/ T0.SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo,/**科目号**/ T4.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName,/**科目名称**/ T0.BAL_FLAG as balFlag,/**余额方向**/ T0.O_AMT as oAmt /**科目余额**/ FROM BOK_BALANCE T0 JOIN BOK_BOOKSET T1 ON T0.BOOKSET_ID = T1.BOOKSET_ID JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' /**只取产品数据**/ JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE T3 ON T0.BALANCE_DATE = T3.BOOKSET_DATE /**关联账套日期表取到当前账套最新账套日期，到期或者全部赎回跑批后，最新账套日期即要查询的数据源**/ AND T1.BOOKSET_ID = T3.BOOKSET_ID JOIN BOK_SUBJECT T4 ON T0.SUBJECT_NO = T4.SUBJECT_NO AND T1.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL = T4.BOOKSET_ID WHERE T0.O_AMT != 0 AND T2.FINPROD_ID IN (
SELECT A.FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT A JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' AND B.BUSI_TYPE IN (17, 21, 27) /**只查询业务类型为：产品的TA交易**/ AND B.PS = 'C5' /**只查到期交易**/
UNION ALL SELECT C.FINPROD_ID FROM (SELECT A.FINPROD_ID, SUM(DECODE(B.PS,'C1',1,'C2',1,'C3',1,'C10',1,-1) * B.PRIN_AMT) AS REMAINAMT FROM FIN_PRODUCT A JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' AND B.BUSI_TYPE IN (17, 21, 27) /**只查询业务类型为：产品的TA交易**/ AND B.PS IN ('C1', 'C2', 'C3', 'C4', 'C5', 'C6', 'C10') /**只查询影响份额的交易方向**/ GROUP BY A.FINPROD_ID) C WHERE REMAINAMT <= 0
)
AND T0.BOOKSET_ID IN
#{booksetId}
AND T2.MDATE <= to_date(#{bookDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
